# VIIBEDEALER - Art Brief

*Generated by `tools/make_assets_doc.py` from `tools/blender/vbd_layers.py`.*
*Regenerate rather than editing by hand, so the brief and the code cannot drift apart.*

This is exactly what to deliver to replace the placeholder art. Dropping final files
in requires **no code changes**: the rig reads layer names, pivots, z-order and
animation channels from `assets/manifest.json`.

---

## What to deliver

One transparent PNG per layer listed below, plus a regenerated `manifest.json`.

| Property | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Format | PNG, RGBA, 8 bits per channel, straight (non-premultiplied) alpha |
| Colour space | sRGB, no embedded ICC profile |
| Resolution | Deliver at **@2x**; the 1x set is derived by downscale |
| Character canvas | 512 x 1024 at 1x (1024 x 2048 at @2x) |
| Dragon canvas | 1024 x 512 at 1x |
| Scene canvas | 1024 x 640 at 1x |
| Alignment | **Every layer full-canvas, same origin.** Do not crop or trim - the pipeline crops and records the offset |
| Naming | `<group>_<layer>.png`, e.g. `character_front_hair.png`, `dragon_wing_l.png` |

## Pivot convention

Pivots are **normalised canvas coordinates**: `0,0` is the top-left, `1,1` the
bottom-right, x right and y **down**. They are semantic rather than geometric - hair
swings about the scalp, not about the centre of its bounding box. If your artwork
moves a feature significantly, update the pivot in `vbd_layers.py` to match.

## Style

Original characters only. Nothing may reproduce an existing anime character, studio
design, or logo.

- Clean line art with cel shading: two or three flat tones per surface, soft gradient
  only in the falloff, no painterly rendering.
- A glowing rim light in the neon palette, reading as light rather than as an outline.
- The character is an **adult** original female character. The dragon is serpentine,
  eastern-styled, and coils around the fractal visualiser.

Palette, matching `src/gui/Theme.h`:

| Role | RGB | Hex |
|---|---|---|
| Neon (primary accent) | 0.21, 0.94, 1.00 | `#36F0FF` |
| Violet | 0.54, 0.50, 0.83 | `#8A80D4` |
| Magenta | 1.00, 0.31, 0.85 | `#FF4FD9` |
| Amber | 1.00, 0.71, 0.27 | `#FFB545` |
| Lime | 0.55, 1.00, 0.42 | `#8CFF6B` |
| Deep (near-black) | 0.08, 0.09, 0.16 | `#141729` |

## Mutually exclusive variants

Only one of each set is drawn at a time. Deliver all of them, aligned to each other:

- Eyes: `eyes_open`, `eyes_half`, `eyes_closed`
- Mouth: `mouth_neutral`, `mouth_open`, `mouth_smile`

## Animation channels

What each channel does to a layer that declares it. A layer may declare several and
their effects compose. Channels the code does not recognise are ignored, so new ones
can be added to the art before the rig understands them.

| Channel | Effect |
|---|---|
| `band_energy` | Brightness driven by the matching fractal band's live energy. |
| `blink` | Vertical squash to zero and back. Fires at random intervals of 1.6-5.8 s. |
| `breathe` | Slow idle breathing, about 0.28 Hz. Vertical scale, roughly 1%. |
| `eye_track` | Small translation following the mouse pointer. |
| `fire` | Alpha driven by input transients and the roar state. |
| `ghost_trail` | Redrawn at earlier spline phases when a delay is on. |
| `head_bob` | Vertical offset locked to host tempo, taken from the playhead. |
| `look_at` | Rotation towards the mouse pointer. |
| `low_energy` | Extra rotation proportional to bass energy in the output. |
| `mouth` | Selects one of the mouth variants. Only one is drawn at a time. |
| `react` | One-shot emphasis when the character is clicked or the randomiser fires. |
| `roar` | One-shot scale-up when the dragon is clicked. |
| `spectral_glow` | Colour wash whose hue follows the spectral centroid of the output. |
| `spline_0` | Rides position 0 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_1` | Rides position 1 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_10` | Rides position 10 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_11` | Rides position 11 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_2` | Rides position 2 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_3` | Rides position 3 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_4` | Rides position 4 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_5` | Rides position 5 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_6` | Rides position 6 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_7` | Rides position 7 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_8` | Rides position 8 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_9` | Rides position 9 along the dragon's spline path. |
| `spline_head` | Rides the head position at the front of the dragon's spline. |
| `sway_fast` | High-stiffness spring rotation. Secondary motion on top of sway_slow. |
| `sway_slow` | Low-stiffness spring rotation about the pivot, driven by low-end energy. |
| `tail_drag` | Rotation driven by the user dragging the tail along its arc. |
| `wing_flap` | Vertical scale oscillating at half the host tempo. |

---

## Delivering the files

1. Export each layer at @2x, full canvas, transparent background.
2. Replace the matching files under `assets/layers/@2x_*.png`.
3. Run `python tools/postprocess.py assets` to crop, derive the 1x set and rewrite
   the manifest.
4. Rebuild. No source changes are needed.

To regenerate the placeholders instead, or after editing `vbd_layers.py`:

```
python tools/build_assets.py            # needs Blender; not needed to build the plugin
python tools/make_assets_doc.py         # regenerate this document
python tools/preview_assets.py character preview.png
```
